problem: First-time spatial intake required a complete prior room program before the client could interpret original requirements.
implemented: Optional conditions_only baseline accepts no prefilled program/relations or lighting requirements
Lighting room use remains unknown until explicitly interpreted; prefilled classifications are rejected in this mode
Original physical/source cross-field checks are retained through schema extension
Source-linked interpretations and complete source coverage precede formal adoption and design
Existing full-input preparation, frozen conditions and historical records remain compatible
Scoped capabilities expose the conditions file schema; public skill describes limits and use

testFixtureCorrections: Initial coverage incorrectly linked source metadata without quotations; corrected test links without weakening product checks
Initial test used an oversized whole-program quote; replaced with exact per-row quotes and conflict/unresolved source dispositions

limits: Test-supplied interpretations and known development inputs, not an independent AI or client trial
Physical/source conditions must still be explicitly supplied; arbitrary CAD extraction is not introduced
At least one valid room program is still needed to compile a spatial draft; no placeholder rooms or invented unknown values
Conditions-only mode does not automatically choose task kind, decide document authority or certify semantic coverage
Existing classified uses and task history use the original input/revision workflows
No new CAD/PDF, optical assessment, standard applicability or professional acceptance in this increment
M2, M3 and M4 remain incomplete; external users and clean machines remain unverified

evidence.location: Private local evidence directory; no project files included in public source
